desc:
Synopsis
Ten years after the war between the devil and the good, Zhang Xiaofan disguised as Gui Li, in the devil's internal struggle to conquer the four sides. At this time, the death of the swamp treasure out of the world attracts all forces to fight, Gui Li and Lu Xueqi reunite, and the two fall into deeper love and hate entanglements. After the Gui Li because of the disappearance of subordinates traced to the burning incense valley, accidentally rescues nine-tailed fox Xiaobai, access to the ancient witch clan clues, and ultimately the Gui Li after nine deaths, finally begs to master the soul of the wizard promised to go to the rescue of Bi Yao, ten years of long-cherished, how the results ......
